id: \bRaichu!
en: \bRaichu!
it: \bRaichu!

id: \rDo you know how to find hidden items?
en: \rDo you know how to find hidden items?
it: \rSai come trovare gli strumenti nascosti?

id: \rTo find hidden items look for different patches of grass or rocks.
en: \rTo find hidden items look for different patches of grass or rocks.
it: \rPer trovare gli strumenti nascosti cerca chiazze d'erba o rocce diverse dalle altre.

id: \rYou could also use an Item Finder.
en: \rYou could also use an Item Finder.
it: \rPuoi anche usare un Cercaoggetti.

id: \bYou'll need at least two Pokémon if you want to battle us.
en: \bYou'll need at least two Pokémon if you want to battle us.
it: \bTi servono almeno due Pokémon se vuoi sfidarci.

id: \rAh, a Trainer! Lets go Haley!
en: \rAh, a Trainer! Lets go Haley!
it: \rOh, un Allenatore! Andiamo, Haley!

id: \rYou don't always have to evolve your Pokémon.
en: \rYou don't always have to evolve your Pokémon.
it: \rNon sei sempre obbligato a far evolvere i tuoi Pokémon.

id: \bThe cave is cleared!
en: \bThe cave is cleared!
it: \bLa grotta è libera!

id: \bI can't wait to explore.
en: \bI can't wait to explore.
it: \bNon vedo l'ora di esplorarla.

id: \bThe cave is blocked up...
en: \bThe cave is blocked up...
it: \bLa grotta è bloccata...

id: \rDid you see that scary woman trying to steal Pokémon?
en: \rDid you see that scary woman trying to steal Pokémon?
it: \rHai visto quella donna spaventosa che cercava di rubare i Pokémon?

id: \rShe almost took my Gardevoir.
en: \rShe almost took my Gardevoir.
it: \rPer poco non si prendeva il mio Gardevoir.

id: \rThose Pokémon. I'm taking them.
en: \rThose Pokémon. I'm taking them.
it: \rQuei Pokémon. Me li prendo io.

id: \rThis is not over. You will give me what I want.
en: \rThis is not over. You will give me what I want.
it: \rNon finisce qui. Mi darai quello che voglio.

id: \bHowdy.
en: \bHowdy.
it: \bSalve.

id: \bNever would have thought I would lose. Good job.
en: \bNever would have thought I would lose. Good job.
it: \bNon avrei mai pensato di perdere. Bel lavoro.

id: \rI'm always trying to make the best snacks. Please try some.
en: \rI'm always trying to make the best snacks. Please try some.
it: \rCerco sempre di preparare gli spuntini migliori. Assaggiane un po', ti prego.

id: \rSugar and I will be here if you want to visit.
en: \rSugar and I will be here if you want to visit.
it: \rIo e Sugar saremo qui, se vuoi passare a trovarci.

id: \rI need to get away for a while.
en: \rI need to get away for a while.
it: \rHo bisogno di staccare per un po'.

id: \rI know town is close, but it feels nice to be here.
en: \rI know town is close, but it feels nice to be here.
it: \rLo so che la città è vicina, ma qui si sta bene.
